# JSON3 test fixtures

Deterministic neutral Arabic captions written by the Balligh team for structural parser tests (more than 300 events, split segments, newline-only events, stable original-index ids). They are project-owned (MIT) and describe a library day and a train trip; they are not transcripts of any recording.
